Preserve source object/metadata and its prior valid mapping on parse or non-mapping failure. Change only sources.py and app/test_reload.py, retain original tests, and do not broaden to environment refresh or all-source atomicity.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
